summary: Cimpress plc filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) disclosing the completion of its acquisition of the SAXOPRINT and viaprinto businesses of CEWE Stiftung & Co. KGaA. No terms (price, premium, stake) were provided; the filing references a prior announcement on May 11, 2026. The acquired businesses will integrate into Cimpress’s PrintBrothers segment. No board recommendation or advisors are named. The transaction is closed. Watch for investor updates on integration and financial impact.
